Hi Ally — great to meet you earlier. Quick checklist so we can expedite procurement and finance:

1) DPA: Please sign Redwood's standard DPA via DocuSign (link below). We need an executed copy before we can finalize contract paperwork. If you prefer to countersign your DPA instead, send it over and legal will review — that will add time.
   - DocuSign (Redwood DPA): https://docusign.example.com/redwood/dpa/hs7f2
   - Attached for reference: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf (PDF, our template)

2) SOC 2: Please provide either a SOC 2 Type II report PDF or a secure portal link and access instructions. If the report is under NDA, mark it and we'll route to our security team.

3) Subprocessors: a simple spreadsheet with name, country, purpose, and contact is ideal (we'll accept an XLSX).

4) Tax & banking: W-9 and bank details should be sent to finance (Marcus CC'd). Please do not include bank info in public threads — use the secure upload instructions below.

5) PO process: Finance issues a PO after we have an executed DPA and the required compliance artifacts. Standard payment terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated. If you need expedited payment or different terms, flag that now.

Upload / secure links: 
- Secure upload for compliance docs: https://files.redwoodinference.com/vendor-uploads (request a one-time token to neha@redwoodinference.com)
- Secure bank info portal (Finance): https://payments.redwoodinference.com/vendor-banking

If you can return the signed DPA and the subprocessor list today/tomorrow, I'll ping Marcus to queue the PO for same-week issuance.

Thanks —

Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0122
